discrepancy_analysis.root_cause: Trapezoidal PR-AUC (scikit-learn auc(recall, precision)) interpolates linearly between precision-recall points, which creates an optimistic approximation over large recall steps. Average Precision (average_precision_score) computes a step-wise Riemann sum weighted by the exact change in recall (AP = sum((R_n - R_n-1) * P_n)). These two metrics are mathematically distinct; the reported numerical differences are mathematically expected and not errors.

discrepancy_analysis.topic: Frequency Experiment Report (0.8652 / 0.9108) vs Bootstrap Metrics (0.8668 / 0.9124)
discrepancy_analysis.root_cause: In frequency_experiment_report.md, images were decoded via cv2.imread(..., cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE), which uses libjpeg's internal fast integer conversion. In phase2b scripts, images were decoded as BGR and converted via cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY). The two routines produce integer rounding variations of magnitude ~10^-4 in 8D features. On 1 borderline sample pair near the 0.5 decision boundary, the continuous prediction rank shifted, changing the Mann-Whitney rank sum by exactly 4 rank positions out of 2500 total pairs (4 / 2500 = 0.0016). The discrete confusion matrices (TP, FP, TN, FN) and accuracy/recall/precision are 100% identical.

paired_mcnemar_test_discordant_pairs.conclusion: Statistically significant difference between spatial baseline and fusion model at alpha=0.01 on this validation set.

assumptions_and_limitations: Pair-aware cluster bootstrap accounts for the non-independence of authentic and manipulated images sharing the same target scene.
Validation set was inspected during exploratory development (Phase 2B/2C); therefore all p-values and CIs are exploratory diagnostics, NOT independent test verifications.
All manipulated samples originate from a single generator (InsightFace inswapper_128); statistical significance does NOT establish cross-generator generalization.
